text.p: SLOVENSKA REPUBLIKA - Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said last year's foreign trade deficit of 64.3 billion crowns was not a reason to devalue the crown.
- Kozlik said the stable economic development would require a closer look at developments in wages, which should reflect economic productivity.
NARODNA OBRODA - The opposition Party of Democratic Left (SDL) said the postponement of banking privatisation beyond March 31 would not endanger Slovakia's attempts to join the OECD.
- The private TV channel Markiza said it was considering taking part in a privatisation tender for one of the two terrestrial networks currently operated by the official Slovak Television STV.

- The Bratislava plant of German car producer VW completed 30,147 cars in 1996, some 371 units more than originally planned. According to preliminary calculations, the value of overall production totalled some 18 billion crowns.
- The opposition Christian Democratic Movement (KDH) said it would draft a law that would allow citizens access to files of former communist secrete police.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar said the proposed indefinite postponement of bank privatisation would have a negative impact on the entire economy and could delay Slovakia's entry to OECD.
- The Slovak banking sector fulfilled this year's second minimum reserves requirements at 1.34 percent above the required amount.
PRAVDA - Damage after the fire that last weekend broke out in the hygienic paper producer PT Zilina is estimated at some 100 million crowns. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-521-8402
